notes.title: Keyword 2: Nightfall is Announced on Steam. 1st Trailer Unveiled!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Detectives! 🌆

We're overjoyed to announce that the sequel to [i]Keyword: A Spider's Thread[/i], titled [i]Keyword 2: Nightfall[/i], is officially in the works! Your unwavering support for the first game has inspired our development team to go all-in, and we're committed to crafting an even more captivating and authentic detective gaming experience.

But that's not all! We're excited to present the FIRST TRAILER that offers a sneak peek into the mesmerizing world of [i]Keyword 2: Nightfall[/i]: 
[previewyoutube=LeTtu9ILRqQ;full][/previewyoutube]

To make this journey truly unforgettable, we need your help, Detectives. 🔍 Head to Steam and add [i]Keyword 2: Nightfall[/i] to your wishlist and be the first to uncover the secrets of the night.

Stay updated on all things [i]Keyword 2: Nightfall[/i] - Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/cityfromnaught]X (Twitter)[/url] and join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/cj2EYpY]Discord Server[/url]. The night is calling, and the mysteries await.
